verdict.rationale: Omarchy's ISO install ("answer five questions") produces a finished desktop with many developer tools preinstalled: Neovim, Lazygit, fzf/zoxide, and OpenCode/Claude Code. Users describe the install as uncomplicated, and there is a bash install script. However, runtimes such as Rails, Laravel and Node.js are added one environment at a time through the Install > Development menu, with Mise managing versions, rather than arriving together from one command. Missing for 10: a single command that provisions all runtimes at once, and documentation of exactly what the base install includes.
